title: Improper fractions
subtitle: Explore the idea with a visual model.
learning_objective: Interpret fractions whose numerator is at least the denominator.

sections.heading: Make sense of it
sections.body: An improper fraction represents one whole or more. Every complete group of denominator-sized parts makes one whole.

sections.heading: Build a picture
sections.caption: Each row represents the same-sized whole.

steps: Group four fourths to make one whole.
Seven fourths contains one group of four.
sections.reasoning: Each step keeps the meaning of the whole and its equal parts clear.

sections.heading: Watch for this
sections.body: The numerator may be larger than the denominator; the fraction is still meaningful.

sections.heading: Your turn
sections.prompt: How many wholes are contained in 9/4?
sections.hint: Use the visual and the worked steps above before choosing.
